Hi all — quick technical clarifications from the SKU side.

- SKU exposure: We publish a billing SKU per SKU-version pair (model+plan). The customer sees the SKU on their GCP invoice; we reconcile via the entitlement ID that GCP returns on purchase.
- Mapping format: CSV with columns {sku_id, display_name, price_unit, entitlement_id}. I attached billing-sku-map-v2.csv (sample).
- Commit vs invoice: For marketplace commit we must register the entitlement IDs before listing go-live. That adds ~48hr prep time for the entitlement sync and a validation window with GCP. Direct invoice avoids entitlement sync but requires separate purchase order handling and manual reconciliation on our side.

Recommendation: If Altitude expects multiple customers to purchase via GCP monthly commits, publish the SKU mapping and use commit flow. It simplifies customer purchase experience and reduces manual invoice handling.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the CSV if that helps.

-Karthik
Director, Listings & Billing Integrations, Redwood Inference
